summary: Iter36 cross-industry Compliance Inbox + integration webhook stubs verified end-to-end. Backend: 21/21 pytest in test_iter36_compliance_inbox.py PASS — /api/compliance-inbox + /api/compliance-inbox/summary return correctly shaped payloads, items sorted critical→info, counts_by_severity sums to total, ?severity=critical and ?industry=transport filters honoured, unauth=401. Created a fresh NHVR occurrence with occurred_at = 25h ago and confirmed it surfaces in /api/compliance-inbox?severity=critical with the expected source_id. IoT temperature webhook (POST /api/integrations/iot/temperature, equipment_type=fridge, temp_c=7.5) creates a temperature_logs row with in_range=false and reason 'Cold storage must be ≤5.0°C (FSANZ Std 3.2.2)' AND the row is visible via /api/hospitality/temperature-logs (round-trip account isolation working). EWD fatigue webhook with work=13h, rest=6h returns breach=true with both reasons populated and source='ewd'. AHPRA poll endpoint is owner-only and stamps last_checked_at; AHPRA webhook upserts existing registration_number row for same account. Academy hospitality catalogue now exposes PEAL anaphylaxis content; AI doc types include peal_anaphylaxis_plan (hospitality), nhvas_audit_pack + nhvr_notifiable_occurrence (transport), sirs_investigation_report (healthcare). Trades regression intact: features/me, /swms, /incidents, /workers all 200, and trades user is hard-blocked (402/403) on /hospitality/temperature-logs, /transport/nhvr-occurrences, /healthcare/sirs-incidents and /retail/lone-worker/active. Frontend: /dashboard renders the new ComplianceInboxWidget (10 CRITICAL banner with top items + Refresh + 'View all'). Sidebar 'Compliance Inbox' nav item is present and routes to /dashboard/compliance-inbox. The full page renders 4 stat tiles (CRITICAL 10, HIGH 19, MEDIUM 1, INFO 0), Severity + Industry filter dropdowns, and 31 inbox row testids each with severity chip + industry chip + kind chip (NHVR/NDIS/SIRS) + 'Nd overdue' indicator. Created TEST_iter36 NHVR row appears as '1h overdue' in CRITICAL group.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/compliance_inbox.py is a clean read-only aggregator over 10 collections (sirs/ndis/ahpra/nhvr/fatigue/lone_worker/temp/haccp/fss/liquor + universal incidents). Account isolation is enforced via account_id_for() filter on every collection lookup — no leakage observed. Severity classification is consistent: <0min ⇒ critical, ≤4h regulator ⇒ critical, ≤24h ⇒ high, ≤30d ⇒ medium, else info. Sorted by (severity_rank, minutes_remaining, due_at).

routes/integrations.py uses _resolve_account() that accepts either x-safebase-integration-token (looked up in account_integration_tokens) OR x-safebase-account header for testing. IoT webhook reuses the same FSANZ Std 3.2.2 thresholds (COLD_MAX, FROZEN_MAX, HOT_MIN) imported from routes.hospitality so behaviour is consistent. EWD webhook applies >12h work / <7h rest as the breach trigger (matches transport.py).
AHPRA poll is owner-only via role_variant check; webhook is account-scoped so a sender cannot mutate another tenant's row.

Frontend ComplianceInboxWidget polls /api/compliance-inbox/summary every 60s and shows top_3 with severity + industry chips and CTA paths — exactly matches backend payload shape. ComplianceInboxPage renders 4 stat tiles + Severity/Industry filter dropdowns + per-row deep-link to industry page — verified rendering with live data.
Minor doc note (no fix needed): subtitle slicing limits SIRS/NDIS summary at 140 chars — could be elided with ellipsis. Item ids are deterministic so React keys are stable across polls.
test_credentials: owner@safetradie.demo / Demo@1234 (works). Login is via POST /api/auth/login → response field is 'token' (not 'access_token'). Frontend stores it in localStorage as 'st_token'.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_iter36 NHVR occurrence (occurred_at = -25h, fatigue_breach), TEST_FRIDGE temperature log (7.5°C breach via IoT), TEST_DriverEWD fatigue log (13h work / 6h rest breach via EWD), TEST AHPRA registration (reg# TESTxxxxxxxx) updated to status=suspended via webhook. All TEST_-prefixed and harmless. User restored to industry='trades' after each industry-switching test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter36 is GREEN. Re-run: export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://safe-systems.preview.emergentagent.com && pytest backend/tests/test_iter36_compliance_inbox.py -v. Endpoints are namespaced: /api/transport/nhvr-occurrences, /api/healthcare/ahpra-register, /api/healthcare/sirs-incidents, /api/hospitality/temperature-logs (returns {rows, total}), /api/retail/lone-worker/active. Compliance Inbox kinds emitted: sirs_notify, ndis_notify, ahpra_expiry, nhvr_notify, fatigue_breach, lone_worker_overdue, temp_breach, haccp_breach, fss_expiry, liquor_expiry, incident_open_long. Integration webhook auth uses 'x-safebase-account: <account_id>' header for local testing (production uses x-safebase-integration-token). Login token is in JSON field 'token' not 'access_token'.
rca of the issue: No bugs. Initial 8/21 failures were all test-side endpoint-path mismatches (used un-namespaced paths like /api/swms/library, /api/nhvr-occurrences, /api/sirs-incidents) — server actually exposes them under /api/<industry>/<resource>. After fixing test paths and the response shape (hospitality returns {rows: [...]}, not {items: [...]}), all 21 tests pass. Server-side contracts and aggregator logic are correct.
